activity.notes: Peter is a historically central first-generation leader of the Jesus movement and early Christian communities within the Roman Empire. His exact career boundaries and martyrdom date are uncertain; ATLAS uses c.30–c.64 CE as a conservative representative apostolic-activity interval rather than treating later ecclesiastical chronology as exact.

sources.title: Peter — The Oxford Research Centre in the Humanities
sources.citation_text: Oxford discusses Simon Peter as the earliest attested bearer of the name Peter and a foundational apostolic figure in early Christianity.

sources.title: Peter, St — Encyclopaedia Britannica (1911)
sources.citation_text: The Britannica article treats Peter as the chief of the Twelve Apostles and reviews the early textual traditions concerning his life and leadership.
